summary: Atari Games' 1999 arcade motorcycle racer with tilting-bike cabinets and linked multiplayer support.

entries.title: Road Burners

emulation.notes: Cabinet motion/tilt and linked multiplayer are part of the original experience.

primary.why: Road Burners was released only for arcades and was built around a tilting motorcycle cabinet that could link up to eight machines, so the arcade cabinet is the complete and highest-authenticity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original arcade hardware; use arcade preservation/emulation only if the Atari/Midway Vegas hardware is supported and legally configured.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Atari/Midway Vegas arcade release with tilting motorcycle cabinet.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release route and complete cabinet experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced home port or remaster.
